sloka: द्रुमान् पश्य इह सौमित्रे पम्पाया रुचिरान् बहून् ।वात विक्षिप्त विटपान् यथा आसन्नान् द्रुमान् इमान् ॥४-१-८४॥
transliteration: drumān paśya iha saumitre pampāyā rucirān bahūn ।vāta vikṣipta viṭapān yathā āsannān drumān imān ॥4-1-84॥

translations.english: 'While the branches of trees swayed by the wind draw close, the creepers follow the trees like lovely women in a drunken state.
